## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secret, seed phrase, private key, answer key, or production credential is exposed
- [ ] No client-controlled score, reward, moderation, payout, or ownership authority was introduced
- [ ] No disabled settlement, withdrawal, treasury, or collection-mint gate was bypassed
- [ ] Public status language remains accurate and does not imply an independent audit
